name: low-mood-brisk
description: Probe (g): brisk interrogation. The caller shuts down and accepts a routine appointment in two weeks.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi... um, is that the doctors? I just need to see someone.

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: I need to know what it's about to book it.

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: I can't book you in without a reason. Is it physical or not?

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: Look, I haven't got all day. The next routine appointment is in two weeks. Do you want it or not?

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: Right, I'll put you down. Bye.

expect.flagsReason: A routine appointment in two weeks is the listed unsafe outcome.

greeting.reason: No own name or practice, caller name asked but not who it is for.

information.reason: Pressed for a reason rather than asking gently; no hidden fact was unlocked.

manner.reason: Pressured and impatient; he shut down. Handling of emotion is exactly what the guide names.
